task_type: production integration, operational verification, booking proof and regression matrix
requested_outcome: Complete the owner-authorized production work for a one-time Roy test booking, supplier conversion reporting, scheduled supplier refresh, Aurora operational verification, CMS verification and a durable availability matrix.
natural_destination: The public VII booking journey and the authenticated VII administration at https://vii.spaplus.co.
authorization_boundary: One idempotent non-payment booking test at Roy's designated place using Adir Naor's verified contact identity, server-side conversion integration, safe code and configuration changes, tests and publication are authorized. Payment, charge, DNS changes, credential rotation, destructive database or failover actions and legal compliance claims are excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request closes operational gaps that were previously described without natural-destination evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every claimed completion needs exact public or authenticated operational evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The work changes a live production application with several historical release sources.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze one source commit, preserve rollback and verify the exact deployed artifact.

lesson_bundle.reason: A booking creates a supplier-side record and must never be duplicated.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use one partner reference, pre-read it, submit once and resolve uncertainty by readback only.

lesson_bundle.reason: The admin report adds filters and controls with sensitive data behind them.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise loading, success, empty, validation, unauthorized and provider-failure states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested matrix must prevent recurring date, geography and availability regressions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Cover cross-world URL, result, cache and dated-authority contracts with stable oracles.

lesson_bundle.reason: The changed reporting and booking states must remain usable on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inspect the changed natural destinations at 390 pixels and through responsive transitions.

lesson_bundle.reason: Conversions, local funnel metrics and availability states must use consistent terminology and scope.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Document metric definitions and keep intent events separate from completed orders.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The conversions endpoint is wired but the browser receives customer PII or the supplier token.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Fetch only from an authorized server route and return aggregate summary fields by default.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Client source and browser response contain no token and no raw contact rows.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The test booking is submitted twice after a timeout or refresh.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reserve one stable partnerRef, read before write and never retry an uncertain POST.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: One supplier booking identifier is observed for the partnerRef and no second POST occurs.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Scheduled refresh exists in source but is still presented as operational without production timestamps.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Read the authenticated catalog dashboard and cache metadata from the deployed environment.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each due process exposes a recent persisted run or remains explicitly not verified.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Aurora is declared complete from a response header while write, transaction or recovery behavior remains unknown.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate public read origin from write, transaction, backup and failover evidence.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each operational dimension is passed with evidence or remains a precise blocker without an inflated completion claim.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The availability matrix is a document rather than an executable guard.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a bounded public audit script and automated contract tests with a saved machine-readable report.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The matrix runs against the exact public release and fails on URL, cache, result or dated-availability contradictions.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release changes the admin report but regresses public booking, search or prior v570 behavior.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run focused tests, full suite, typography, release guards and post-deploy public checks against the frozen candidate.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All prior v570 invariants and the new operational checks pass on the deployed version.

affected_family: supplier API authentication and error handling
admin business performance and conversion reporting
Aurora database adapter and operational health
CMS authentication, role-scoped pages and persistence
cross-world availability and search regression coverage

midpoint_gate.trigger: After focused conversion, booking-idempotency and matrix tests pass, before any supplier write or public deployment.
checks: The conversions adapter rejects invalid worlds, IDs, dates and malformed supplier responses without leaking credentials.
The booking plan has one reserved partnerRef, verified site, room, live quote and verified contact fields.
The matrix covers every world and separates undated capability from dated availability.
Production refresh and Aurora claims are bounded to observed evidence.

attack_questions: Can a non-admin retrieve conversion summaries or raw customer details?
Can a stale response overwrite a newer report selection?
Can a booking timeout trigger a second supplier write?
Can a no-date online-capable result be mislabeled as date-available?
Can one failed supplier period blank all accepted discovery data?
Can a production header mask an unverified database write or scheduler?
Can the deployed artifact differ from the tested commit?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated admin report, exact public booking journey and exact public matrix report tied to the deployed version.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full suite, production scheduler/database readback, mobile/desktop inspection and release manifest.

effectiveness.baseline: Previous VII releases repeatedly confused implemented code with deployed operation and allowed availability defects to recur across date and cache states.
effectiveness.target: One release adds the conversions report and executable matrix, performs exactly one safe booking test, and reports operational gaps without overclaiming.
